verdicts.reason: A: the 'ONLINE ONLY' badge sits right on top of the CTA so 'Try It' can't be read, the button looks squashed and smeared, and the content block floats with a lot of dead orange space below and to the right. B: everything is readable and the CTA is the strongest element, but the phone and its backing circle are jammed against and clipped by the left edge, the badge is crowded up against the CTA, and the bottom-right cluster sits tight to the canvas edge.
